raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add the GB300 Kimi-K3 disaggregated Dynamo + vLLM profile from [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4047](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4047) to the recipe's interactive selector, as requested in [this review comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4047#issuecomment-6276636819). #62528 documented the profile as guide text only; this encodes it in the structured `pd_cluster` fields so GB300 + **Prefill/Decode Disaggregation** + the **Dynamo** PD router (`?pd_router=dynamo`) renders the qualified prefill and decode commands. Only `recipes/models/moonshotai/Kimi-K3.yaml` changes.

## Claims

- GB300-scoped `strategy_overrides.pd_cluster` additions:
  - `hardware_overrides.gb300` (both roles): TP8 + DCP8 (`--decode-context-parallel-size 8 --dcp-comm-backend a2a`, direct-DCP env), `TOKENSPEED_MLA`, fp8 KV, `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`, prefix caching with `--prefix-match-unit 128`, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.92`, `--max-cudagraph-capture-size 512`, `--enable-cumem-allocator`, the DSpark K4 draft (`Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark`, probabilistic draft sampling, block verification), and the NCCL/UCX/connector env.
  - Prefill: two trays (`nodes: {gb300: 2}`, TEP8), `--moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe`, `trtllm_ragged_backend: cute-dsl`, `--max-num-seqs 64`, `VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS=1`, `VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT=0`.
  - Decode: `parallelism: {default: dep, gb300: tp}` on two trays, `tokenspeed_mla_min_split_kv: 8`, `VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS=0`, and overrides for the DEP-only decode flags (`--no-data-parallel-hybrid-lb`, `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`, `cudagraph_mode` FULL_AND_PIECEWISE). The GB300 decode MegaMoE entry is dropped because this decode pool has no expert parallelism.
- One guide line points from the existing GB300 section to the selector and lists what stays guide-only.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <this checkout>/recipes` from vllm-project/recipes passes; `git diff --check` is clean.
- Rendered `pd_cluster` through `resolveCommand` for GB300 with the Dynamo router (ranks 0 and 1): the prefill and decode argv/env match the qualified InferenceX launch lines for these settings.
- Rendered `pd_cluster` (native router and Dynamo) for GB200, B300, B200, H200 and MI355X: byte-identical to `main`.

## Details

- **Guide-only, because the schema has no field for them:** xPyD worker counts (1P2D-2P5D; the builder renders one pool per role), the qualified MooncakeStore `MultiConnector` options and Mooncake master (the KV Offload row's Mooncake option emits its generic connector last), and the Dynamo frontend's `least-loaded` router mode with 900 s session affinity (the frontend's router mode comes from `strategies/pd_cluster.yaml`).
- **Rendering notes:** role `vllm_args` apply to every GPU and the renderer cannot remove a flag per hardware, so GB300 shows both `--no-enable-prefix-caching` / `--enable-prefix-caching`, `--data-parallel-hybrid-lb` / `--no-data-parallel-hybrid-lb` and (prefill) `--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune` / `--enable-flashinfer-autotune`; argparse applies the later flag, which is the qualified value. The existing pd_cluster Blackwell `UCX_TLS=rc,cuda_copy` still applies on GB300.
- `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384` is vLLM's API-server default on >=160 GB GPUs (`vllm/engine/arg_utils.py`), which is what the qualified decode ran with.

## Render re-verification

Re-checked with `resolveCommand` against the qualified launch lines of [InferenceX run 39140771499](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39140771499): every GB300 prefill and decode serving flag matches; the only difference is the benchmark-only synthetic acceptance in the run's speculative config. The contradictory-looking pairs (`--no-enable-prefix-caching` / `--enable-prefix-caching`, `--data-parallel-hybrid-lb` / `--no-…`, `--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune` / `--enable-…`) come from shared pd_cluster role flags that a model recipe cannot remove per GPU; the GB300 value is always emitted later, so argparse keeps it. Other hardware and strategies render byte-identically to main. Companion: #62542 (GB200) is stacked on this branch.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

files.patch:
@@ -408,9 +408,77 @@ strategy_overrides:
       blackwell:
         extra_env:
           UCX_TLS: "rc,cuda_copy"
+      # GB300: the InferenceX AgentX xPyD profile (SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4047),
+      # TP8 + DCP8 pools across two trays with the DSpark K4 draft. The pd_cluster
+      # Blackwell block above replaces the recipe Blackwell baseline, so the
+      # shared serving flags are restated here; role blocks below add the rest.
+      gb300:
+        extra_args:
+          - "--decode-context-parallel-size"
+          - "8"
+          - "--dcp-comm-backend"
+          - "a2a"
+          - "--attention-backend"
+          - "TOKENSPEED_MLA"
+          - "--kv-cache-dtype"
+          - "fp8"
+          - "--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype"
+          - "bfloat16"
+          - "--enable-prefix-caching"
+          - "--prefix-match-unit"
+          - "128"
+          - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
+          - "0.92"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "512"
+          - "--enable-cumem-allocator"
+          - "--enable-flashinfer-autotune"
+          - "--load-format"
+          - "fastsafetensors"
+          - "--stream-interval"
+          - "10"
+          - "--language-model-only"
+          - "--speculative-config"
+          - '{"model":"Inferact/Kimi-K3-DSpark","attention_backend":"TOKENSPEED_MLA","method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block"}'
+        extra_env:
+          VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_A2A: "1"
+          VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_Q_GATHER: "1"
+          VLLM_USE_DIRECT_DCP_KV_GATHER: "1"
+          VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER: "1"
+          VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM: "0"
+          VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1"
+          VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL: "0"
+          NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "1"
+          NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE: "1"
+          NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "1"
+          NCCL_P2P_LEVEL: "NVL"
+          VLLM_CONNECTOR_PREFETCH_DEPTH: "8"
+          VLLM_CONNECTOR_PREFETCH_KV_CAP: "0.65"
+          VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS: "4"
+          MC_SLICE_SIZE: "1048576"
+          MC_MAX_MR_SIZE: "4294967296"
+          MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY: "1"
+          UCX_MEMTYPE_CACHE: "n"
+          UCX_MEMTYPE_REG_WHOLE: "n"
+          UCX_RCACHE_MAX_UNRELEASED: "1024"
+          UCX_TCP_AF_PRIO: "inet"
     prefill:
       parallelism: tep
       tp: 8
+      nodes:
+        gb300: 2
+      hardware_overrides:
+        gb300:
+          extra_args:
+            - "--moe-backend"
+            - "deep_gemm_mega_moe"
+            - "--attention-config"
+            - '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"trtllm_ragged_backend":"cute-dsl"}'
+            - "--max-num-seqs"
+            - "64"
+          extra_env:
+            VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT: "0"
+            VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS: "1"
       vllm_args:
         - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
         - "16384"
@@ -419,18 +487,36 @@ strategy_overrides:
       env:
         VLLM_KIMI_K3_SHARD_SP_SHARED_EXPERT: "1"
     decode:
-      parallelism: dep
+      # GB300 decode is a TP8 + DCP8 pool without expert parallelism (#4047);
+      # every other GPU keeps the DEP decode pool.
+      parallelism:
+        default: dep
+        gb300: tp
       tp: 1
+      nodes:
+        gb300: 2
       env: {}
       hardware_overrides:
         gb200:
           extra_args:
             - "--moe-backend"
             - "deep_gemm_mega_moe"
         gb300:
+          # Undo the DEP-only decode flags below for the TP pool. Hybrid LB is
+          # invalid on the --headless follower; 16384 is vLLM's API-server default
+          # on >=160 GB GPUs, which the qualified decode ran with.
+          # FULL_AND_PIECEWISE is vLLM's V1 default; it replaces the strategy's
+          # FULL_DECODE_ONLY, which the qualified decode did not set.
           extra_args:
-            - "--moe-backend"
-            - "deep_gemm_mega_moe"
+            - "--no-data-parallel-hybrid-lb"
+            - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+            - "16384"
+            - "--compilation-config"
+            - '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}'
+            - "--attention-config"
+            - '{"mla_prefill_backend":"TRTLLM_RAGGED","use_prefill_query_quantization":true,"tokenspeed_mla_min_split_kv":8}'
+          extra_env:
+            VLLM_ENABLE_GEMM_RS: "0"
       vllm_args:
         - "--data-parallel-hybrid-lb"
         - "--no-enable-prefix-caching"
@@ -666,6 +752,8 @@ guide: |
 
   Prefill workers always use `--max-num-seqs 64`.
 
+  The command builder renders one prefill pool and one decode pool of this profile: select GB300, **Prefill/Decode Disaggregation** and the **Dynamo** PD router. Worker counts beyond 1P1D, the Mooncake store connector and services, and the frontend's router mode and session affinity below are documented here only.
+
   ### Services
 
   Start etcd, NATS and a Mooncake master once:
